subject: SBIC identity and the exact phrase 'SBIC, ChatGPT SBIC'
resolution: SBIC in Japan is not uniquely one nationwide legal entity. Official sources identify three separate regional sister companies that use SBIC East/Central/West Japan branding.

source_quality: Primary official company profiles are the controlling identity evidence. The three websites cross-reference each other, so they are complementary primary records but not wholly independent corroboration.
